g.text: Where the CPU goes, from B to Cp, by thread group

Exploratory, computed after the fact. Each panel is one session with its own binary (its code commit in its title): compare bars within a panel only. C's process CPU in M1 / M1.1 / M2: 8 channels 18.56 / 19.49

/ 18.74 s (5.0% apart); 5 channels 35.68 / 37.45 / 37.28 s (5.0% apart). M4's C8 is M2's Cp. M2's and M4's main conditions stagger the channels' sampling. "saturated": its session labels it so (M4 §3.2); the

step to it compares unequal loads. A bar is the sum of the threads in threads.csv (those alive at the window's end); it differs from the process CPU above it by at most 0.03 s on average. In a segment: CPU s
(share of process CPU). Mean ± sample sd of 3 runs; ratios of the means.
